body:
T 9:40pm ingested 6 0.25mg tablets.
T 9:50pm I feel unchanged.. Maybe slightly tired I'm gonna sit up and put a movie in now to pass the time.
T 10:00pm still feel the same nothing exciting or enlightening, if I had to guess I'd guess this night is gonna be uneventful; but let's see what another thirty minutes may bring.
T 10:10pm well still nada.. No exciting qualities of this substance what so ever it would seem. Abuse potential for this med is questionably high but I don't see the value in it.. Maybe a higher dose? But everywhere online it talks about how 2mg (8 .25mg) is considered a od level? Maybe this is just an overhyped benzo although 10/10 sleep aid I've used it as prescribed 4 a night and had no problems sleeping anyhow see y'all in another ten minutes.
T 10:20 just smoked some resin yuck I know but the boredom just got so bad that I had to add something in the mix..still feel no effects from the triazolam besides your usual anti anxious feeling only a benzo can provide, and that seems to be pretty good on a person like me I'm a anxious mess on this stuff I'm calm as a cucumber.
T 10:30 feeling like I just want to give up on this experiment and go to bed its so boring and is making me more and more tired.. I'm sure the weed has more of a play in that though from my experience triazolam tends to just calm my mind so I can drift off to sleep at lower doses like 1 pill for a average guy is usually enough to knock them on their butt so to speak.. See y'all in ten minutes
T :10:40 now I'm getting a kind of fuzzy sight everything has a slight blur to it and in beginning to feel ever more drawn to lay down and attempt to go to sleep.
T 10:50 thing ate same old same old
T12:05pm really feeling the need to lie down gone end the trip with disappointment unfortunately I did sniff 1.5 mg the only effect I have is bring on my nose and a clogged nose. Btw time seemed to speed up cause I was on top of those ten minute updated then boom 2 hours later wtf
My final thoughts,
Otherwise this is a great rx for sleep and if used for that alone as long as i'm not using for long periods of time
